[[Rendezvous with the Infiltrator]] | next = [[Genn Greymane Must Die!]] }} == Objectives == Slay 8 Spitecrest Netters for Blackthorn at Blackthorn's Camp in Gilneas. * [[Spitecrest Netter]] slain (8) ==Description== You may wonder why a gaggle of humans are working with the Horde. The answer to that question lies in the Civil War in the Plaguelands, when we Forsaken first gained liberty... Yes, we Forsaken. You see, I am a banshee currently possessing Blackthorn, and I have convinced his band of cutthroats to fight for us. Rest assured, I am not alone in this endeavor. If you wish to know more, then you will need to earn my trust. Some of those naga creatures have been encroaching upon the camp from the beach. Slaughter them and we will resume our conversation upon your triumphant return. ==Progress== Shall we continue the tale? ==Completion== You have done well. Following the victory of the Forsaken, those who possessed a body during the conflict were sent out as the Dark Lady's eyes and ears. My group is usually sent to spy upon the Alliance as we are suited for blending in among humans. I have come to grow fond of my comrades in this group. They lacked discipline and purpose once, but are now skilled infiltrators and spies. ==Progression== {{To Gilneas}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.17.0|note=Added.}}
